name: hf_kitti360_gs_subset
title: KITTI-360 street chunks as point clouds and Gaussian splats (GaussianWorld subset, 16 chunks)
description: Sixteen chunks of KITTI-360 sequence 0000 pre-processed by GaussianWorld: per chunk the accumulated LiDAR point cloud (pc_coord.npy, ~3 M points, with segment ids) and a fitted Gaussian splat stored as separate arrays (coord, color, opacity, scale, quat). Coordinates are in the KITTI-360 world frame with offsets above 1 000 m - keep float64. This is the dataset the pl.load feasibility test of 2026-10-03 ran on (one chunk of 43 MB fetched in 5.5 s, ground removal unchanged).

license.note: The Hub card declares no licence; KITTI-360 upstream is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (non-commercial, share-alike), inherited here. TO CONFIRM with the GaussianWorld authors for the splat fits.

citation: Liao Y., Xie J., Geiger A. KITTI-360: A Novel Dataset and Benchmarks for Urban Scene Understanding in 2D and 3D. TPAMI 2022.

points.description: Accumulated LiDAR points of the chunk (KITTI-360 world frame, metres)

point_segments.description: One segment id per LiDAR point (meaning of the ids TO CONFIRM)

gaussian_centers.description: Centres of the fitted Gaussians (same frame as the points)

gaussian_color.description: RGB per Gaussian (range 0-1 or 0-255 TO CONFIRM)
